observations: Diagnosis is default when adoption mode is unspecified.
Existing rules, user changes, prior workflow authority and state are preserved.
Direct business code, database, dependencies, globals and other worktrees remain outside the adoption delegation.
Tool refusal is not bypassed with manual writes or weakened policy.
Automatic repairs are limited to explicit index entries, pending registration and mapped broken links.
Prior installation layout requires manual inventory and a separately authorized migration window; current preflight does not claim automatic cross-version discovery.
Resource installation, host loading and native invocation are explicitly separated.
Current process references resolve in candidate governance check; old results are not rebound.
